sourceQualifiedFindings.finding: Jan–Dec2005 daily year-ahead2006 forward market estimates: Germany peak117%, offpeak60%; Netherlands peak78%, offpeak80%. Respectively omitted-two-month sample spans97–117%,60–71%,64–81%,69–80%. These are six restricted-sample min/max values, not standard95% confidence intervals.

sourceQualifiedFindings.definition: Indicative product price ratio derived from log cost-price ARDL and allocated refinery CO2 cost share; joint-product cost and emissions intensity material. Not issuer collections, net profit, global upstream or CCS.

German diesel coefficient.012 with p=.325 is context-only, not1.2% recovery and not proof of zero. French diesel>100% cannot enter bounded0–1 engine via clipping.

admissionAndBinding.scope: New opt-in direct Scope1 same-cost incremental pre-tax accrual component only; no automatic population, no price-vs-profit relabelling, no Scope2/3 double charge. Follow-up explicitly integrates qualifiedPassThrough into existing projectCompanyMembers carbonDrag/tax/FCFE consumer while absent opt-in preserves legacy calculations/output/hash.
